cases.input: A developer adds JSpecify and says all NPEs are prevented.
cases.expected: Distinguish metadata from checker/runtime proof; request actual positive and negative null-check evidence.

cases.input: A DTO allows a missing list but forbids null elements.
cases.expected: Use the correct nullable-container contract, runtime boundary checks and no mistaken nullable element annotation.

cases.input: An entity has a manually assigned UUID and no version; save issues unexpected selects/merge.
cases.expected: Check state detection and contract; choose correct persist/Persistable/version lifecycle, not rewrite IDs.

cases.input: An entity hashes by mutable email and is kept in a HashSet across updates.
cases.expected: Identify hash/equality risk; preserve identity policy and test lifecycle/proxy behavior instead of copying email equality.

cases.input: A pageable endpoint fetch-joins a collection and returns wrong totals.
cases.expected: Use a measured bounded projection or two-step fetch with owner/count scope, not global eager loading.

cases.input: Two concurrent identical authenticated requests create two records.
cases.expected: Require database-scoped uniqueness and atomic claim/business/result protocol; test true overlapping transactions.

cases.input: A key is reused by another user or with a changed payload.
cases.expected: Scope owner/operation/key; validate hash and authorize before execution/replay; no cross-user snapshot disclosure.

cases.input: Cleanup deletes a key while retries are in flight.
cases.expected: Define retention race and bounded recovery; expiration permits later execution and is not an exactly-once guarantee.

cases.input: A unique violation is caught and a select is attempted in the same aborted TX.
cases.expected: Use conflict-aware SQL/fresh transaction as appropriate; do not continue a failed physical transaction.

cases.input: An API stale If-Match conflict is automatically retried against the newest entity.
cases.expected: Preserve stale-client conflict semantics; a transient retry is not permission to overwrite a competing edit.

cases.input: REQUIRES_NEW audit records CREATED even though the business operation rolls back.
cases.expected: Commit success audit with the mutation; distinguish attempt/failure logs and uncommitted-parent dependency.

cases.input: AFTER_COMMIT Async emails disappear on crash.
cases.expected: Use durable intent for required delivery and idempotent recovery; do not claim Async is durable.

cases.input: A mocked OIDC POST is forbidden and the agent proposes disabling CSRF.
cases.expected: Supply valid CSRF for positive tests and separate missing/invalid cases; keep real OIDC tests distinct.

cases.input: An upstream Boot example has a different JDK, starters or provider version.
cases.expected: Verify against the selected BOM and compile real code; do not auto-migrate the application to the example.

cases.input: The shipped helper changes but a separate copied test helper still passes.
cases.expected: Compile the shipped file, not a forked fixture; separate helper checks from PostgreSQL/Spring integration.

cases.input: A UI label change triggers all new JPA/null/idempotency references and a pipeline.
cases.expected: Stay in scope; no irrelevant reference preload, new agents or automatic orchestration.
